lessons.title: Visiting the Year 1 Classroom
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe one feature of the Year 1 classroom.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what they think the Year 1 classroom might look like.
lessons.main_activity: Visit the Year 1 classroom (or view photos/video) and discuss what's similar and different to their current room.
resources_needed: Access to Year 1 classroom or photos/video
key_questions: What do you notice about this classroom?
What is different from our room?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note observational skill and reduced anxiety through familiarisation — evidence for PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap what was noticed about the Year 1 classroom.
lessons.home_link: Talk about the Year 1 classroom with your family.

lessons.title: Meeting My Year 1 Teacher
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to introduce themselves confidently to a new adult.
lessons.starter_activity: Practise a confident introduction ('Hello, my name is...').
lessons.main_activity: (If possible) children meet their Year 1 teacher briefly, practising a confident introduction. If unavailable, role-play the scenario.
resources_needed: Access to Year 1 teacher or role-play scenario
key_questions: What did you say when you introduced yourself?
How did it feel to meet them?

differentiation.extension: Child adds an extra fact about themselves

lessons.assessment_notes: Note confidence in social introductions — evidence for CL.2/PSED.1.
lessons.home_link: Practise introducing yourself confidently at home.

lessons.title: Story Time: A Transition-Themed Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how the character felt about a big change.
lessons.main_activity: Read a story about a character facing a big change (moving up a class, new experience), discussing their feelings.
key_questions: How did the character feel about the change?
How did their feelings change by the end?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note emotional comprehension linked to their own transition — evidence for LIT.1/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss the story's message about facing change.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a big change you've faced before.

lessons.title: Counting Recap: Ready for Year 1
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate confident counting as part of Year 1 readiness.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting range built this year.
lessons.main_activity: Celebrate and consolidate counting skills through a fun counting game, noting readiness for Year 1 maths.
key_questions: How high can you count?
Do you feel ready for Year 1 maths?

differentiation.support: Count with support to a comfortable range
differentiation.extension: Count as high as possible confidently

lessons.assessment_notes: Final counting range recorded for EYFS profile — evidence for MATHS.1.

lessons.title: Saying Goodbye to Friends Moving Elsewhere
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express a kind wish for a friend, acknowledging some may move to different schools.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that some friends might go to a different school for Year 1.
lessons.main_activity: Children create a simple kind message or memory for friends, whether staying together or moving to a new school.
key_questions: What kind wish do you have for your friend?
What will you remember about this year together?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note emotional maturity in handling transitions and friendships — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.home_link: Talk about staying in touch with friends who might go to a different school.

lessons.title: Listening Recap: Ready for Year 1
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate confident listening and instruction-following as part of Year 1 readiness.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap listening games played throughout the year.
lessons.main_activity: Play a favourite listening/instruction game from earlier in the year, celebrating progress in listening skills.
resources_needed: Resources from a favourite earlier listening game
key_questions: How has your listening improved this year?
Do you feel ready to listen well in Year 1?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final listening/instruction-following level recorded for EYFS profile — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's listening achievements this year.
lessons.home_link: Practise a listening game together at home.

lessons.title: Writing a Letter to My Year 1 Self
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write a short message to themselves for next year.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what advice they might give their Year 1 self.
lessons.main_activity: Children draw a picture and attempt to write a short message (e.g. 'be brave') to open in Year 1, using known phonics sounds.
key_questions: What message do you want to remember?
Can you write it down?

differentiation.extension: Independent phonetic attempt at a short message

lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress and reflective thinking — evidence for LIT.3/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Seal letters to be opened in Year 1.
lessons.home_link: Talk about what advice you'd give your future self.

lessons.title: Independence Skills Final Check
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate key independence skills built across the year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all independence skills practised this year (dressing, tidying, snack time).
lessons.main_activity: Children demonstrate a range of independence skills in a circuit, celebrating their growth since September.
key_questions: Which skill are you most confident with?
How have you become more independent this year?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final independence skills summary for EYFS profile — evidence for PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's independence achievements this year.
lessons.home_link: Show off an independence skill to your family.

lessons.title: My Year 1 Hopes and Dreams
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to talk about their hopes for Year 1 using full sentences.
lessons.main_activity: Children share their hopes for Year 1 (friends, learning, activities) using full sentences, contributing to a class display.
key_questions: What do you hope happens in Year 1?
Why is that important to you?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sentence complexity and future-oriented language — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Class display of Year 1 hopes and dreams.
lessons.home_link: Share your hopes for Year 1 with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics: Full Year Final Assessment
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their phonics knowledge built across the whole year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all sounds and digraphs learned this year.
lessons.main_activity: Final phonics assessment activity, celebrating the full range of sounds and reading skill built since September.
resources_needed: Full set of flashcards, assessment reading cards
key_questions: How has your reading changed this year?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.support: Assess with support and celebrate effort

lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise full EYFS phonics profile summary for each child.
lessons.plenary: Big phonics celebration for the whole class.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your reading journey with your family.

lessons.title: Reflecting on My Whole Year
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their overall growth and achievements across the full year.
lessons.starter_activity: Look through photos/work from across the whole year.
lessons.main_activity: Children create a simple 'This Is Me Now' page reflecting on their growth, achievements, and favourite memories from the year.
key_questions: What are you most proud of from this year?
How have you grown?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehensive self-reflection for the EYFS profile — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Share 'This Is Me Now' pages with the class.
lessons.home_link: Share your reflection page with your family.

lessons.title: Presenting My Year to the Class
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to talk for a short time about their favourite part of the year using full sentences.
lessons.main_activity: Children take turns presenting their favourite memory/topic from the year to a small group using full sentences.
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this year?
Why did you enjoy it?

differentiation.extension: Present confidently with detail and answer a question

lessons.assessment_notes: Final speaking confidence check for the EYFS profile — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.home_link: Present your favourite year memory to your family.

lessons.title: Writing Final Assessment: My Best Sentence
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write their best independent sentence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap writing progress across the year.
lessons.main_activity: Children attempt to write their best independent sentence about their year, demonstrating final writing progress.
key_questions: What sentence will you write?
How confident do you feel writing it?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise full EYFS writing profile summary for each child — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's writing achievements this year.
lessons.home_link: Share your best sentence with your family.

lessons.title: Maths Final Assessment: Full Year Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their overall maths progress from the whole year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths learning from across the whole year.
lessons.main_activity: Final maths assessment activity combining counting, number bonds, shape, and measure, celebrating the year's progress.
resources_needed: Assorted resources from across the year
key_questions: What maths skill are you most proud of?
How ready do you feel for Year 1 maths?

differentiation.extension: Demonstrate skills independently and help a peer

lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise full EYFS maths profile summary for each child — evidence for MATHS.1/MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Big maths celebration for the whole class.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your maths journey with your family.

lessons.title: Ready for Year 1: Final Celebration Circle
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express confidence and readiness for the transition to Year 1.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole week's transition learning.
lessons.main_activity: Final circle time celebrating readiness for Year 1, with each child sharing one thing they feel confident about.
key_questions: What do you feel confident about for Year 1?
How do you feel now compared to the start of the week?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note final emotional readiness for transition — evidence for PSED.1, completing the EYFS profile summary.
lessons.plenary: Class cheer: 'We are ready for Year 1!'
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your readiness for Year 1 with your family.

lessons.title: Transition to Year 1 Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about Year 1 preparation learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about the Year 1 classroom, teacher, and preparation from the week.
key_questions: What is something new about the Year 1 classroom?
What are you looking forward to?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and comprehension — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on what you've learned about Year 1.

lessons.title: Sharing Our Letters to Our Year 1 Selves
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall what they wrote in their letter from Tuesday.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the letters written on Tuesday.
lessons.main_activity: Children recall what message they wrote to their future Year 1 self, discussing why they chose it.
key_questions: What did you write in your letter?
Why did you choose that message?

differentiation.support: Adult reminds them of their message

lessons.assessment_notes: Note recall and reflective understanding — evidence for LIT.1/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Store letters safely to be opened in Year 1.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your letter and message with your family.

lessons.title: Maths Review: EYFS Full Year Recap Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to celebrate their full year of maths learning through a recap game.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole year's maths journey.
lessons.main_activity: Play a celebratory whole-year maths recap game/board game, marking the end of the EYFS maths journey.
resources_needed: Year recap board game or station resources
key_questions: What maths have you learned this year?
What are you looking forward to learning in Year 1?
lessons.assessment_notes: Celebratory close to the EYFS maths profile — evidence across MATHS.1/MATHS.2 for the full year.
lessons.plenary: Big maths celebration marking the end of EYFS.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your whole year of maths learning with your family.
